steps.objective: Diagnose why the NSVisualEffectView .sidebar vibrancy is not visually translucent on macOS in GAMBIT v0.1 (smoke-test a). The window opens cleanly but the sidebar appears solid. Identify whether the cause is CSS masking, platform-sniff timing, Tauri 2 transparent/titleBarStyle interaction, vibrancy plugin misuse, or a benign macOS-dark-mode subtlety.
Apply the patch identified in VIGIL's root-cause-report so the macOS NSVisualEffectView .sidebar vibrancy renders visibly translucent.
